info.title: API.SH: ZAP Imoveis
info.description: The ZAP Imoveis API from API.SH: public ZAP Imoveis data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: ZAP Imóveis agency profile and listings
get.description:
A ZAP Imóveis advertiser (real estate agency or broker): name, CRECI licence, tier, since date, rating, logo, phones, verified flag, address and listing count, with its listings for sale or rent (price, condo fee, IPTU, rooms, areas, amenities, address, photos), paged.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zap-agency

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A zapimoveis.com.br/imobiliaria/<id>/ link (a listing's advertiser url), or pass id.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The advertiser's number from its link, instead of url.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One ZAP Imóveis listing: title, description, status, types, prices (sale or rent with condo fee and IPTU), accepts exchange, bedrooms, bathrooms, suites, parking, areas, floor, buildings, delivery date, amenities, stamps, dates, external reference, full address with coordinates, photos (resized and original), videos and virtual tour, the site's price estimate (range per m² and for the property), condominium, and the advertiser (agency name, CRECI licence, logo, website, phones, WhatsApp, address and listing counts by city, neighbourhood and business, plus some of its other listings). A private owner's phones and address are left out. Pass `latest=true` with search filters to open the newest matching listing.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zap-listing

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Listing id (the number after id- in a listing link). Or give `url`.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: true: open the first current result of a search made with the other filter params given here (the same as the search route's, e.g. location), instead of `id`/`url`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Cities, neighbourhoods and streets in Brazil matching a name, with zone, city, state, location id, coordinates, search link and match score.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zap-places

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

places.location_id: BR>Rio de Janeiro>NULL>Rio de Janeiro>Zona Sul>Copacabana

get.description:
Homes and commercial property in Brazil on ZAP Imóveis with the site's filters: sale or rent, place (city or neighbourhood), property types, residential or commercial, price, bedrooms, bathrooms, suites, parking spaces, usable area, amenities and sort. Each result has id, link, title, types, prices (sale or rent, condo fee, yearly IPTU), bedrooms, bathrooms, suites, parking, areas, amenities, dates, full address with coordinates, photos, videos and the advertiser (agency name, CRECI licence, logo, page and phones; a private owner's phones are left out). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page (the site shows up to 10,000 results).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zap-search

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: City or neighbourhood name; the best match is used (see /zap/v1/places).

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State name (e.g. São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro), with `city`.

parameters.name: unit_types
parameters.description: Property types, comma-separated: APARTMENT, HOME, CONDOMINIUM, PENTHOUSE, FLAT, KITNET, TWO_STORY_HOUSE, FARM, RESIDENTIAL_ALLOTMENT_LAND, COMMERCIAL_PROPERTY, OFFICE, BUSINESS, SHED_DEPOSIT_WAREHOUSE, COMMERCIAL_BUILDING, COMMERCIAL_ALLOTMENT_LAND, PARKING_SPACE, HOTEL.

parameters.name: amenities
parameters.description: Amenities, comma-separated: POOL, GYM, ELEVATOR, BARBECUE_GRILL, PARTY_HALL, PLAYGROUND, GATED_COMMUNITY, FURNISHED, PETS_ALLOWED, AIR_CONDITIONING, BALCONY, CONCIERGE_24H, SPORTS_COURT, SAUNA, ...

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
